thread:
maria: Heads up — prod pods in cluster-east failing image start. saw KMS decrypt errors in runtime logs. suspect new sealed-image push used wrong signing key. @ajay any quick checks?
ajay: pulling registry logs now. cosign verify shows
  ERROR: verification failed: no matching public key found
looks like image signed by ephemeral key id 'EPH-7f3' not in our kms alias map.
sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-142. Severity: medium. Audit events attached.
noah: timeline Q — did we change signing process last night? we did a small tweak to CI env for feature/fast-build but shouldn't touch prod key.
lina: we rotated the intermediate on 2026-03-12 for compliance, but canonical production signer remained the same. CI should be prevented from using prod keys though.
ajay: reproducer: `cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-prod image:sha256:...` -> fails. `cosign verify --key ~/tmp/ephemeral.pub` -> succeeds. so ephemeral key used by some pipeline job.
maria: can we fallback to previous tagged image? want minimal blast — roll back to image:2026-03-11 if registry still has it.
noah: yes fallback is safest. Proposed playbook: 1) block new tag push (registry rule) 2) update key-alias mapping in infra (add EPH-7f3 -> temp alias) 3) re-sign problematic images with canonical prod key and push new tag 4) restart pods in rolling fashion.
lina: also need RBAC hardening: CI service account currently has `iam.roles/keys.signer` for prod key. we should add condition limiting by repo name and branch and require `signed-by: ci-prover` check. I'll draft a stricter binding.
ajay: opened PR to restrict signer binding + add terraform unit test: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/428. includes a dry-run flag for the CI job to catch accidental signer use.
sec-bot: Audit: added KMS grant request and RBAC-binding-change to the incident timeline.
maria: who can perform emergency re-sign? we need an operator with both KMS grant and registry write. @noah?
noah: I can do the re-sign once access is granted. request in access workflow would be temp grant for `noah-prod-ops` expiring in 2 hours.
lina: access request submitted: ACCESS-889. included justification and expiry.
ajay: quick note — we should also add a post-facto verification job that scans last 24h signed images and flags unknown signer IDs. will add as infra monitor.
maria: SRE coordination — schedule a short maintenance window at 22:15 UTC to perform re-sign & rolling restarts. notify SRE oncall.
oncall-sre: acknowledged. we'll run canary on 3 pods first, will abort if >5% error. recommend 15-minute window.
noah: after re-signing, will push images with immutable tag `sealed-fix-3123456789` and update k8s deployments to that tag. plan to avoid node restarts.
lina: adding audit entries and timeline to ticket; capturing which pipeline ran the ephemeral signer and revoking that token.
ajay: found culprit: ephemeral key was created by build agent in ephemeral-runner for PR #432 — attaching logs to ticket.
maria: good catch. block that runner from GCR access until CI fix merged.
noah: once done, I'll run `cosign verify` across canary and staging and post results. sample command: `cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-prod image:sealed-fix-3123456789`
lina: postmortem owners: maria, ajay, lina. I'll add timeline and remediation items.
sec-bot: Incident update: mitigation in progress. Audit entry: KMS grant created, RBAC PR opened, runner blocked.
maria: thanks everyone. keep thread for final close, and update incident with metrics (failed pod counts, time-to-recover, commits involved).
